platformConstraints.processExecution: CLI native execution; the PWA writes reference templates and plaintext .env files the person asks for by name, and starts no process.
platformConstraints.providerAdministration: 1Password service-account administration and protected token persistence belong to the native CLI. Browser workflows operate on the unlocked local sealed vault using os:// references and do not administer op:// provider service accounts.
platformConstraints.browser-extension: Has no password workflow: it keeps its own sealed candidates and origin grants (ADR 0076) and neither opens nor reads the PWA vault.
platformConstraints.android: Wallet surface is outside password manager workflow by ADR.

protocolMcp.reason: Protocol MCP is a Host capability client and has neither browser-local vault nor native provider custody. Pages WebMCP has separately verified metadata handlers and human workflow handoffs.

platformConstraints.accountProtectedMethods: Pepper and Sphinx require deliberate human input; password workflow agent references, reads and updates refuse these methods. Metadata labels remain available without sealed, evaluator or pepper material.
